name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.FlipShift.stacked_hint_decodes
title: The succinct-LWE hint decodes every slot once the W-part is exposed
statement: If B T k' k + W k' TW k = (if k' = k then G else 0) for all slots k', k, then for secrets s k', slot noises e k' and W-noise eW: sum_k' (s k' B + e k') T k' k + (sum_k' s k' W k' + eW) TW k = s k G + (sum_k' e k' T k' k + eW TW k).
